name: Allow cards
why: How a thread gets a folder or an approval, and how fast you answer in its thread
ideal: One Allow once card per Mac thread, a worktree for a shared folder, and an answer inside the thread within minutes.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects

steps.name: Ask
steps.rule: Ask for a Mac thread only when the task needs your computer.

steps.name: Card
steps.rule: Pick the folder and turn on Worktree when another thread uses it.

steps.name: Answer
steps.rule: Answer in the thread itself. A go-ahead in the project conversation does not reach it.

steps.name: Run
steps.rule: When auto mode is on, the thread runs commands without further prompts.
